name: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash measured on four H200s
title: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash measured on four H200s
summary: Unquantized DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017, on four power-capped H200s, served 16 concurrent workers at more than 150 tokens per second each. The post presents that as a serving setup in the roughly $120,000 machine range.
